transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because there’s been a problem at work. I’m pretty sure some people on this environmental modeling contract are tracking my revisions and putting errors into the datasets so it looks like I can’t lead the project. My wife and some of the junior analysts keep saying it’s probably just version-control mistakes, but it doesn’t feel that way to me.
Have you felt that people are deliberately trying to harm or undermine you in ways that others don’t seem to notice or agree with?

Yes. That’s what I mean about the contract. I’m pretty sure people there are tracking what I change and then putting errors into the datasets afterward, so it makes me look like I can’t handle leading it. Other people keep saying it’s just version-control problems, but that doesn’t fit with what I’m seeing.
Outside of work, do you feel like others are trying to harm or deceive you in ways that other people don’t seem to notice?

Mostly it’s around the work contract. That’s where I notice it — people tracking my revisions and then somehow errors showing up in the datasets after I’ve worked on them. My wife says I’m reading too much into it, and the junior analysts say it’s version-control stuff, but I don’t think that explains it. Outside of that, I’m not as sure.
Have you ever felt that people not related to your work are also trying to harm or trick you in some way, even if others don’t seem to notice it?

Not really outside of that, no. It’s mainly the people tied to that environmental modeling contract. I feel like they’re watching my revisions and then errors show up in the datasets afterward, like they’re setting me up to look incompetent. My wife and the junior analysts keep saying it’s just version-control mistakes, but I don’t buy that.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts or actions are being controlled by outside forces or that someone is influencing your work without your consent?

I wouldn’t say my thoughts are controlled, exactly. It’s more that I’m convinced someone on that environmental modeling contract is interfering with my work without my permission — tracking my revisions and then putting errors into the datasets after I’ve worked on them. My wife and the junior analysts say it’s probably version-control mistakes, but it doesn’t feel like that to me.
Have you ever had any unusual or persistent thoughts about your personal relationships, your identity, or your physical health that others don’t seem to share or understand?

No, not really about my health or identity or relationships. It’s more this work thing. I’m here because I’m pretty sure the people on that environmental modeling contract have been tracking my revisions and putting errors into the datasets afterward, to make it look like I can’t lead the project. My wife and the junior analysts keep saying it’s version-control mistakes, but that doesn’t add up to me.
Have you ever had any thoughts or beliefs that others you’ve talked to have said are not true or realistic, outside of the issues you’re having at work?

No, outside of work I don’t really have beliefs like that. It’s this contract situation. I know they say I’m being unrealistic, my wife and the junior analysts, but I’m pretty sure someone’s tracking my revisions and planting errors in the datasets so it looks like I can’t lead the work.

Do you believe these people on the environmental modeling contract are part of a larger plan or coordinated effort against you, or is it something you think is happening more independently around your work on the project?

I don’t know if I’d call it a larger plan. It feels more tied to this project and the people on that contract. I’m pretty sure someone there is tracking my revisions and then planting errors in the datasets after I’ve worked on them, so it looks like I can’t lead the work. My wife and the junior analysts keep saying it’s just version-control mistakes, but I don’t buy that.
Have you ever had any beliefs or suspicions that others have told you are not true, that aren’t related to your work on this environmental modeling contract?

No, not really. I mean, people tell me I’m wrong about this work situation, about the contract and the datasets, but outside of that I can’t think of anything. It’s mainly that I’m sure they’re tracking my revisions and putting errors in after the fact, and everyone keeps saying it’s just version-control mistakes.
Have you ever had any strong beliefs or suspicions that you think are definitely true, but others have strongly disagreed with, even when there was no evidence they were trying to harm you?

Yes. I mean, it’s really this contract situation. I’m pretty sure they’ve been tracking my revisions and then planting errors in the datasets so it looks like I can’t lead the work. My wife and some of the junior analysts keep telling me it’s just version-control mistakes, but that doesn’t seem right to me.

Even though your wife and the junior analysts have said it’s just version-control mistakes, do you still feel certain that someone is deliberately tracking your revisions and planting errors in the datasets, with no doubt at all?

Yes. I mean, I know people keep saying it’s version control, but I don’t really believe that. I still think someone on that contract is watching what I change and then putting errors in afterward so it falls back on me. I wouldn’t say I have no doubt at all, but... I’m pretty certain that’s what’s happening.

Even though your wife and the junior analysts have explained that the issues could be version-control mistakes, do you still believe, without any doubt, that someone is intentionally tracking your changes and planting errors in the datasets?

Yes. I mean, I know they keep saying it could just be version-control mistakes, but I don’t buy that. I still believe someone on that contract is tracking my changes and putting errors into the datasets so it looks like I can’t handle leading the work.

Even though your wife and the junior analysts have explained that the issues could be version-control mistakes, do you still believe, without any doubt, that someone is intentionally tracking your changes and planting errors in the datasets?

Yes, I still believe it. I know they say it’s version-control mistakes, but that doesn’t explain it to me. It feels like people on that contract are tracking my revisions and then planting errors in the datasets so it looks like I can’t lead the work.

Do you believe that the people interfering with your work are acting together in a coordinated way to harm you, or is this something you think is happening independently among individuals on the contract?

It feels coordinated to me. I don’t think it’s just random people making mistakes on their own. The way my revisions get tracked and then the dataset errors show up afterward… it seems like people on that contract are working together to make me look like I can’t lead the work.

Even though your wife and the junior analysts have given explanations that don’t involve deliberate interference, do you believe, with absolute certainty, that your revisions are being tracked and errors planted in the datasets by others on the contract?

Yes. I know my wife and the junior analysts say it could be version-control mistakes, but I don’t believe that explains it. I’m pretty sure people on that environmental modeling contract are tracking my revisions and planting errors in the datasets to make it look like I can’t lead the work.
